Bug_Title: EC: Using pointer equality to compare different types (EC_UNRELATED_TYPES_USING_POINTER_EQUALITY)
Bug_Details:
This method uses pointer equality to compare two references that seem to be of
different types. The result of this comparison will always be false at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates using pointer equality to compare two references that are of different types, specifically a String and an Integer. Since they are unrelated types, the comparison will always evaluate to false.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testPointerEqualityWithDifferentTypes' triggers the bug by passing a String and an Integer to the 'showBug' method. The method uses pointer equality to compare these unrelated types, which will always return false. The test expects true, causing the test to fail and thus revealing the bug.
